description: Browse the SPP Marketplace public file archive — the raw published market data behind every SPP report, back to 2013. Lists folders and files (name, path, size, modified) for a dataset, or downloads one file as parsed rows. Datasets include rtbm-lmp-by-location, da-lmp-by-location and the other Marketplace feeds. Use when you need a SPECIFIC historical interval, day or dataset rather than the current snapshot.

dataset.description: Marketplace dataset name, e.g. "rtbm-lmp-by-location" or "da-lmp-by-location". This is the fsName in SPP's own file browser.

download.description: true = treat `path` as a FILE and return its parsed rows instead of a directory listing. Default false.

limit.description: Max entries or rows to return (default 100, max 2000).

path.description: Folder or file path inside the dataset, e.g. "/" or "/2026/09/By_Interval/17". Default "/".

name: spp_files
title: Spp Files
